expected_structural_delta: Zero new lifecycle owners, stores, schemas, dependencies or production layers; one shared status observer helper and focused regression fixtures.
minimum_design: Disable inherited Docker healthchecks at shared create and read shared runner status through immutable host-side Docker inspection; preserve native lifecycle and legacy providers.
outcome: Shared GitHub runners remain observable during native freeze without periodic health or UI probes spawning container execs.

reuse_decisions.rationale: All new shared GitHub owners pass through existing gated create adapter.

reuse_decisions.rationale: Existing owner preserves workers, remote idle proof, settlement and fenced release.

reuse_decisions.rationale: Shared-only host-side process observation removes unlocked UI exec race while legacy behavior stays intact.
